name: Intermezzo "Sunset Spritz" by Bully Boy
description: Inspired by the classic Spritz, citrus and spice notes including yuzu, grapefruit, cinnamon & clove
serverNotes:
🌅 ABOUT: Non-alcoholic spritz from Bully Boy (Boston, MA), inspired by the classic Spritz.

🍹 PROFILE: Bittersweet & bright | Yuzu and grapefruit with warm cinnamon and clove | Bubbly

🍽️ PAIRS WITH: Appetizers, antipasto, salads, pizza.

💡 SERVING TIP: Zero-proof pick for spritz lovers; local producer.

name: Intermezzo "Alpine Highball" by Bully Boy
description: Inspired by the Alpine Amaro of Northern Italy, bitter, sweet & herbal notes
serverNotes:
⛰️ ABOUT: Non-alcoholic highball from Bully Boy (Boston, MA), inspired by the Alpine amari of northern Italy.

🍹 PROFILE: Bitter, sweet & herbal | Alpine herbs, gentle bitterness, refreshing fizz

🍽️ PAIRS WITH: Pork Belly, meatballs, charcuterie, richer dishes.

💡 SERVING TIP: For amaro fans who are not drinking alcohol.

name: Pear Blossom
description: Pear purée, lemon juice, Fever-Tree Elderflower Tonic & vanilla bean
serverNotes:
🍐 ABOUT: Elegant non-alcoholic cocktail with pear purée, fresh lemon, Fever-Tree elderflower tonic & vanilla bean. Sophisticated & refreshing!

🍹 PROFILE: Fruit-Forward & Floral | Sweet pear, bright lemon, delicate elderflower & warm vanilla | Light, effervescent | Beautiful presentation!

🍽️ PAIRS WITH: Cheese plates, pork dishes, autumn salads, roasted chicken, light appetizers.

🍰 DESSERT PAIRINGS: Apple tart, pear crisp, vanilla panna cotta, crème brûlée.

💡 SERVING TIP: Perfect for guests who want sophistication without alcohol. Great for designated drivers, expecting mothers, or anyone preferring alcohol-free options!

name: Toothless Mule
description: Apple cider, passionfruit purée, rosemary, Fever-Tree Ginger Beer
serverNotes:
🦷 ABOUT: Playful spin on Moscow Mule without the 'bite'! Apple cider, passionfruit purée, fresh rosemary & Fever-Tree ginger beer. Bold & refreshing!

🍹 PROFILE: Spiced & Tropical | Crisp apple, exotic passionfruit, herbaceous rosemary & spicy ginger | Effervescent kick | Great ginger warmth!

🍽️ PAIRS WITH: Pork chops, roasted chicken, autumn dishes, Asian cuisine, grilled vegetables.

🍰 DESSERT PAIRINGS: Apple pie, ginger cookies, tropical fruit, caramel desserts.

💡 SERVING TIP: The name is a fun nod to Moscow Mule! Perfect for guests who love ginger beer but want alcohol-free. Great year-round but especially popular in fall!

name: Free Spritz
description: Blood Orange, Cranberry Purée, Lime, Sage, Fever-Tree Sparkling Grapefruit and Giffard Apéritif Non-Alcoholic Syrup
serverNotes:
🍊 ABOUT: Aperol Spritz vibes without the alcohol! Blood orange, cranberry purée, lime and sage, topped with Fever-Tree Sparkling Grapefruit and Giffard's non-alcoholic apéritif syrup.

🍹 PROFILE: Bright & bitter-sweet | Blood orange, tart cranberry, grapefruit and a herbal hint of sage | Effervescent | Sunset color

🍽️ PAIRS WITH: Italian appetizers, antipasto, salads, seafood, light pasta.

🍰 DESSERT PAIRINGS: Sorbetto, fruit tart, panna cotta, citrus cake.

💡 SERVING TIP: For guests who love an Aperol Spritz but want it alcohol-free.

name: Blueberry Bombshell (Mocktail)
description: Blueberry Purée, Lemon Sorbet, Pineapple Juice, Sparkling Water
serverNotes:
💙 ABOUT: Non-alcoholic version of our popular Blueberry Bombshell! Blueberry purée, lemon sorbet, pineapple juice & sparkling water. Instagram-worthy & refreshing!

🍹 PROFILE: Berry-Tropical Fusion | Sweet blueberry, tart lemon sorbet & tropical pineapple | Beautiful layered effect | Light, fun & fruity!

🍽️ PAIRS WITH: Brunch dishes, fruit salads, light salads, eggs benedict, pancakes.

🍰 DESSERT PAIRINGS: Berry tart, lemon cake, fruit sorbet, panna cotta, cheesecake.

💡 SERVING TIP: The sorbet keeps it cold while creating visual appeal! Perfect for celebrations, kids' special occasions, or anyone wanting the cocktail experience without alcohol. Crowd-pleasing favorite!

name: Raspberry Mojito (Mocktail)
description: Fresh Raspberries, Mint, Lime, Simple Syrup, Soda Water
serverNotes:
🍓 ABOUT: Non-alcoholic version of our signature Raspberry Mojito! Fresh raspberries, muddled mint, lime & soda water. Classic mojito refreshment without the rum!

🍹 PROFILE: Fruity & Herbaceous | Sweet raspberry, fresh mint, bright lime & effervescent bubbles | Crisp & cooling | Perfect summer refresher!

🍽️ PAIRS WITH: Salads, seafood, light dishes, Cuban-inspired cuisine, grilled chicken.

🍰 DESSERT PAIRINGS: Berry tart, lime sorbet, fruit salad, key lime pie, raspberry cheesecake.

💡 SERVING TIP: Fresh mint muddled for authentic mojito character! Perfect for warm weather, celebrations, or guests who love classic cocktails without alcohol. Great for designated drivers & expecting mothers!
